{{Quote|It kind of reminds me of a tout board I saw at a million-credit betting parlor on Bragkis, and everyone standing around waiting for the race to begin. Who’s got a favorite? What odds will you give me on Wakiza?|Han Solo|<ref name="SL" />}}
'''Bragkis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|I|90|Bragkis}}</ref> located in the [[Bragkis system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Sometime before the [[Black Fleet Crisis]],<ref name="SL" /> Bragkis was home to a million-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] betting parlor, where [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once spent some time.<ref name="SL" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bragkis was first mentioned<ref name="SL" /> in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|31|Lucasfilm's Latest}}</ref> In [[1998]],<ref name="San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives">{{ThisWeek|-BZX-WxjhFE|San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives, Brand New LEGO Art, and More!|sw_url=video/san-diego-comic-con-exclusives-brand-new-lego-art-and-more|date=2020-07-02}}</ref> an entry for Bragkis was added to the reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which revealed that it was a planet.<ref name="SWE" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Bragkis system/Legends|Bragkis star system]] and the planet itself in grid square R-6.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
